question: What do a shape's Shape style, Individual corner radii, Color and Stroke offer, and what does each write?
page: a new blank page, a new Shape at 1/2/7/8, 341.7 by 235.6, nothing saved, a 1600 wide window
rows: Stroke Color and Thickness with a stroke

style.note: The name goes on data-shape-name. The picker closes on a click. Only Rectangle keeps the Uniform and Individual buttons. The SVG has preserveAspectRatio none, so a shape fills its block with Stretch on.

stretchOff.note: The shape keeps its own proportions, as large as fits, centred both ways.

corners.path: arcs of 10, 20, 30 and 40 at those corners
corners.backToUniform: every corner takes the top left's value, 10; the field reads 10px

picked.reset: Reset to theme appears under the bar

reads: the five swatches and the color as a sixth

color.note: The Stroke Color popup has the swatches and Custom color, no Opacity slider while no custom color is on.

stroke.custom: A fourth button, three dots, opens a range 212 wide and a value, 6px, under Thickness

rect.note: A rectangle's stroke sits outside its box: at M the drawn box is -3, -3, 347.7 by 241.6, the path's stroke runs from -6 to 0. Its corner loses half the stroke: 10 reads as a 7 arc at M.

other.note: Other shapes keep vector-effect non-scaling-stroke: 6px at M on a circle stretched to the block.

notMeasured: the curves of each shape: ours are our own drawings of the same name and proportions (O2)
a section theme's own shape color
a stroke and a color per layout
rows_demoShape: 2026-11-05, read only on the demo page's two rectangles: the same rows as a new Shape, Stroke included. This corrects SHAPEDESIGN.json, whose 'no Background or Stroke row' does not hold.
knownDifferences: The curves of the 28 shapes with a path are our own drawings of the same name and proportions (O2), so only name, proportions, box and stroke are compared
A plain rectangle is a div with border-radius until it has a stroke, where the oracle always draws an svg
With four corners and a stroke, ours strokes every corner at the top left's radius
inferred: Stretch off for shapes whose box was not read: the rule (as large as fits, centred) comes from the five read
The proportions in the block of the shapes with no Stretch off box come from the picker's own view boxes, not from a box in the block
Where the three-dot range ends: ours 1 to 50
Reset to theme on Stroke Color
Where the picker and the color popup sit on the screen
